none: PAS NLM-441CB3: Roman Coin: Radiate of Gallienus from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Gallienus (253-268), 'zoo mint' issue. Obverse description: Radiate bust right; tight curled beard beneath chin. Obverse inscription: [---]S AVG. Reverse description: Antlered stag standing right. Reverse inscription: [AN]NONA [?AVG]. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 1.99gms, die axis: 6
